normalized_text: a few weeks ago i tweeted about the specific subject i'm going to be talking about in this video and then i realized just a few days ago while going through that he mentions the exact same argument let's go through these verses together remember when he overwhelmed you with drowsiness giving security from him then after distress he sent down upon you security in the form of drowsiness overcoming affection of you so allah the almighty is actually saying that he brought down upon the muslims during war during the battle of badr in the battle of a form of drowsiness in order to calm their nerves now don't worry the drowsiness didn't prevent the muslims from defeating the disbelievers and the battle of badr as for the battle of this occurred after the surprise attack against the muslims it helped them calm their nerves and help them survive the battle enemies narrated that abu talha said i raised my head to look around on the day of and there was not one of them that day except that he was swaying under his shield due to drowsiness of course this is a supernatural event that did actually occur i mean if it didn't occur then the prophet peace be upon him wouldn't be reciting these verses publicly and i mean doing that would put his whole case for prophethood at jeopardy that's all i have for this one i'll see you guys in the next one that's allah about it
